translation_source_policy: Translated directly from the audited German source slice; English control slice reserved only as a sanity witness.

technical_exclusions.disposition: Section 2 and later content; not included in this checkpoint

segment_summaries.content: Section heading for fields K_{n rho} and systems S_{n rho}.
segment_summaries.choices: Kept the K/S fraktur notation and translated the surrounding field/system terms directly.

segment_summaries.content: Scope statement: systems of rational functions in n indeterminates, especially rational-function fields.
segment_summaries.choices: Unbestimmte continues as indeterminates rather than variables.

segment_summaries.content: Conventions for rational functions, reduced representation, polynomials, coefficient field Omega, and parameters.
segment_summaries.choices: Reduced representation rendered as shortened/reduced representation; whole rational functions explicitly identified as polynomials.

segment_summaries.content: Degree-zero functions from Omega counted as part of the system.
segment_summaries.choices: Nullten Grades rendered as degree zero in all languages.

segment_summaries.content: Abstract definition of a rational-function field after these conventions.
segment_summaries.choices: Rationaler Funktionenkörper aligned with Paper 05/intro field terminology.

segment_summaries.content: Definition I: closure conditions under scalar multiplication, addition, multiplication, and quotient; finite adjunction notation for special fields.
segment_summaries.choices: Adjunktion rendered as adjoining/prisоединение/adjunkcija; quotient notation f:g preserved.
Zwischenkörper rendered as intermediate field / medžupolje; Cyrillic Steinitz normalized to Штайниц.

segment_summaries.content: Alternative formulation of rational-function field as intermediate field between Omega and Omega(x_1,...,x_n).
segment_summaries.choices: Wirklich enthält rendered as genuinely/really contains all n indeterminates.

segment_summaries.content: Introductory sentence for algebraic rank as characteristic number.
segment_summaries.choices: Algebraischer Rang rendered directly as algebraic rank.

segment_summaries.content: Definition II of algebraic rank with footnote defining algebraic independence/dependence.
segment_summaries.choices: Formula text kept close to source; lambda identity wording made explicit in Slavic prose.

segment_summaries.content: Double-index notation S_{n rho} and K_{n rho}, and inequality 1 <= rho <= n.
segment_summaries.choices: Doppelindex rendered as double index; Interslavic corrected to dvojnym indeksom.

segment_summaries.content: Lead-in to examples of K_nn and K_nrho.
segment_summaries.choices: No modernization needed beyond compact prose.

segment_summaries.content: Example 1: Lagrange genus domains as K_nn fields and inclusion of symmetric functions.
segment_summaries.choices: Lagrange genus-domain phrase continues from Paper 05 and remains review-flagged.

segment_summaries.content: Example 2: projective invariant fields, determinant-one transformation footnote, homogeneous isobaric invariants as systems.
segment_summaries.choices: Invariant theory vocabulary kept stable; determinant 1 footnote retained in full.
